## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build, CI or tooling
- [ ] Breaking change

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun run audit`
- [ ] `bun test`

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow `type(scope): description`.
- [ ] Documentation under `docs/` is updated.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased.
- [ ] No new dependencies, pretrained weights, secrets or private data.
